For every nonempty proper S within connected C, q_C(S)>0, so zero-δ transient chain drains to empty with invertible triangular generator. Recursive first-step perturbation gives probability hδ(S)=δ^{m−|S|}H_C(S)+O(δ^{m−|S|+1}). Each excursion out of empty succeeds with probability δ^{m−1}k_C/r_C+O(δ^m), while excursions have bounded moments and empty waiting is Exp(δr_C). Geometric thinning therefore yields Exp(k_C) on δ^{−m} time, with mean/UI. Components use independent clocks; global hitting is max, smaller components vanish on leading scale. Separate exact CTMC on 3-vertex path (one zealot) yields Eτ=4(1+δ)/δ², limit 4, confirming exponent and coefficient.
